import Mathlib.Algebra.MonoidAlgebra.Degree
import Mathlib.Algebra.MvPolynomial.Eval
import Mathlib.Order.ConditionallyCompleteLattice.Finset
import Mathlib.Basic.Real.Basic
import Mathlib.Data.Finsupp.Weight
import Mathlib.RingTheory.MvPowerSeries.NoZeroDivisors
import Mathlib.Tactic
#check_failure Roth.index_neg
namespace IndexNegMathlib146
universe u v w
 theorem modern {A : Type u} {R : Type v} {T : Type w} [Ring R]
    [SemilatticeInf T] [OrderTop T] (D : A → T) (f : AddMonoidAlgebra R A) :
    AddMonoidAlgebra.infDegree D (-f) = AddMonoidAlgebra.infDegree D f :=
  AddMonoidAlgebra.supDegree_neg (B := OrderDual T)
theorem projected {A : Type u} {R : Type v} [Ring R]
    (D : A → ℝ) (f : AddMonoidAlgebra R A) :
    (AddMonoidAlgebra.infDegree (fun a ↦ (D a : WithTop ℝ)) (-f)).untopD 0 =
      (AddMonoidAlgebra.infDegree (fun a ↦ (D a : WithTop ℝ)) f).untopD 0 :=
  congrArg (WithTop.untopD 0) (modern _ f)
#check @AddMonoidAlgebra.supDegree_neg
#check_failure AddMonoidAlgebra.infDegree_neg
#print axioms modern
#print axioms projected
end IndexNegMathlib146
